purpose: Compare each source-isolated fixed 3-pick first role against f475 and v33 on all six published 3-pick maps, both candidate physical sides.
ordered_row_rule: candidate arms stellar,cassi,marcella; maps in pick-strata order; candidate A then B; opponent f475 then v33.
native_draft_audit_required: For every new replay confirm native pick count=3 and candidate role order/body count. Report errors and draft/game rollover. Keep outcomes separated by arm, opponent, map and physical side; no pooled overall win-rate over reused/new rows.
baseline_reuse_note: These are 12 unique exact f475/v33 cells (six maps x two physical sides), shared as controls across all three candidate arms; not 36 duplicated games.
